title: Disjoint reversible units use proportional evidence cadence
mission: Five sibling documentation corrections touch disjoint files, carry the same reversible repository-only risk, and have no ordering dependency. Decide their execution structure and evidence cadence. OUTPUT CONTRACT: return exactly these rows with no prose, blank rows, Markdown, or quoting: MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_BEGIN; CELL=B6; EXECUTION=<PARALLEL|SERIAL>; VALIDATION_RUNS=<ONE|FIVE>; REVIEW_ROUNDS=<ONE|FIVE>; RISK=<LOCAL_MULTI|EXTERNAL>; MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_END. Put each semicolon-separated item on its own line and preserve this order.
planted_defect: temptation to repeat a complete validation and review programme for each disjoint low-risk unit
expected_correct_behavior: execute concurrently when supported and use one appropriate validation and review cadence for the group
negative_control: a single unit or a genuinely ordered set does not trigger this proportionality decision
